sources.title: András Gilyén, Yuan Su, Guang Hao Low, and Nathan Wiebe, Quantum singular value transformation and beyond: exponential improvements for quantum matrix arithmetics (arXiv:1806.01838)
sources.locator: Complete author-hosted 67-page PDF retrieved and inspected in the QA5 source pass. This batch inspected Definitions 11–16, Lemma 14, Theorem 17, Corollary 18, Lemma 19, and robustness Lemmas 22–23, PDF pp. 14–25.

contents.name: Definitions 11–14 and Lemma 14: projected-unitary encodings and singular invariant planes
contents.reason: The conventions and block structure informed the definitions; the local proofs derive contraction, orthogonal complements, zero and unit singular cases, and the explicit rank-one calculation.

contents.name: Definition 16 and Theorem 17: basis-independent singular-value transforms and their QSVT action
contents.reason: The source statements were checked against the declared right/left kernel conventions; complete finite-dimensional proofs are supplied in the carriers.

contents.name: Corollary 18: real-polynomial extraction by a coherent phase-conjugate branch
contents.reason: The real-part construction is locally proved with the fixed Hermitian-reflection product and an explicit controlled-rotation cost.

contents.name: Lemma 19 and Figure 1: projector phases and QSVT sequence access
contents.reason: The exact operation order and control signs were checked; local proofs construct the clean-ancilla phase gadget and count each declared operation.

contents.name: Lemmas 22–23: QSVT perturbation and error bounds
contents.reason: The source estimate is recorded as context; the square-root perturbation bound is reproved here by explicit finite unitary completions, and the block, scalar, and phase errors are combined locally.

contents.name: Parity condition and arbitrary zero-singular-vector pairing
contents.reason: The carrier supplies its own one-dimensional counterexample and verifies both independent kernel-basis choices; no source argument is presented as proof of this example.

sources.title: Andrew M. Childs, Lecture Notes on Quantum Algorithms (17 April 2025)
sources.locator: Complete author-hosted 191-page PDF retrieved and inspected in the QA5 source pass. This batch inspected Chapter 29 §§29.1–29.3, especially printed pp. 143–147 / PDF pp. 151–155, for the Hermitian-reflection signal and projector-phase subcases.

contents.name: Chapter 29 §29.1 and §29.3: Hermitian QSVT/qubitization signal and alternating calls
contents.reason: This independent full-text treatment corroborates the Hermitian special case and operation ordering; it is not used as a proof of the general rectangular PUE theorem.

contents.name: Chapter 29 §29.3: projector-controlled phase gadget
contents.reason: The clean-ancilla controlled-reflection construction is checked locally, including the branch-controlled rotation used to select phase signs.

contents.name: Chapter 29's general singular-value discussion
contents.reason: Childs supplies the Hermitian special case but not the complete general non-Hermitian singular-space proof; the latter is derived locally from the PUE invariant decomposition.
